cards.question: Céline Dion's My Heart Will Go On is the theme song from which film?
cards.answerExplanation: My Heart Will Go On is the theme song from Titanic. It also won the Academy Award for Best Original Song.
cards.whyNow: Céline Dion sang with a fan in Paris ahead of her scheduled Saturday comeback show, making her familiar songs timely again.

coreFactSources.publisher: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
coreFactSources.title: The 70th Academy Awards | 1998

newsPegSources.headline: Céline Dion duets with fan ahead of Paris comeback concert

cards.question: Despite its name, a light-year measures which quantity?
cards.answerExplanation: A light-year is the distance light travels in one Earth year. Light takes time to arrive, so distant objects also show us the past.
cards.whyNow: NASA's September 11 astronomy image features M83, described as about twelve million light-years away, making this easily confused unit timely.

newsPegSources.headline: APOD: 2026 September 11 – M83: The Southern Pinwheel

cards.question: Steel is made mainly from which metal?
cards.answerExplanation: Steel consists primarily of iron combined with a small amount of carbon. It is a mixture of elements, not a separate metallic element.
cards.whyNow: Alan Lovell's appointment as Chair of British Steel was announced on September 11, bringing the material behind the business into focus.

newsPegSources.headline: Alan Lovell appointed Chair of British Steel

cards.question: A painting described as a diptych consists of how many panels?
cards.answerExplanation: A diptych has two parts. Traditional examples are often hinged so they can close like a book, protecting the paintings inside.
cards.whyNow: The government announced a temporary export bar on Stanley Spencer's The Resurrection of the Good and the Bad, a diptych.

newsPegSources.headline: Minister acts to stop pivotal British Modernist painting from leaving the UK

cards.question: What is the main aim of basic scientific research?
choices: Developing a product for a specific use
Understanding phenomena without a specific application in mind
Designing a prototype to meet a practical need
cards.canonicalAnswer: Understanding phenomena without a specific application in mind
cards.answerExplanation: Basic research seeks new understanding without a particular application in view. Applied research instead pursues a specific practical aim; development creates or improves products and processes.
cards.whyNow: NSF's September 10 statement described changes to research support and highlighted both basic and applied research, making their different goals worth distinguishing.

coreFactSources.publisher: National Center for Science and Engineering Statistics, U.S. National Science Foundation
coreFactSources.title: Definitions of Research and Development: An Annotated Compilation of Official Sources

newsPegSources.headline: NSF leadership in a new golden age of science
